newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African police arrest cocaine courier at airport.
newsitem.headline: S.African police arrest cocaine courier at airport.

text.p: South African police seized cocaine worth an estimated 780,000 rand ($174,000) and arrested a woman at Johannesburg's International Airport at the weekend, a spokewoman said on Monday.
The cocaine was concealed in baby powder bottles, containers of fruit and roll-on deodorant bottles hidden in the 30-year-old woman's luggage, police Inspector Ina Middel said in a statement.
The courier, a South African, had been on a flight from Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo in Brazil, police said.
